instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Put a file I sell (a book, an audiobook, a course video) behind paid access so only buyers can open it", and give it file (The file to sell, in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it); object_key (The name buyers ask for the file by, like "chapter-one.pdf"); required_access_refs (The access refs your offers grant; a buyer holding any one opens the file, like ["access:course-a"]).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:seal-a-paid-file and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Encrypts one of the person's files with their paid-files key (AES-256-CTR, a fresh nonce per file), keeps the sealed copy in their files, and writes the file's paid-file record: the name buyers ask for it by, the sealed copy's identity, how it is sealed, the key's NAME and the access refs a buyer must hold (any one of them opens it).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: paid-file (records:write).
